customerPerTransactionLimit.description: Maximum single online transfer by a customer (USD).

customerDailyTransferLimit.description: Maximum total online transfers per source account per day (USD).

customerApprovalThreshold.description: Online transfers above this amount require manager approval (USD).

newBeneficiaryLimit.description: Maximum transfer to a beneficiary within 24 hours of activation (USD).

managerApprovalLimit.description: Managers may approve transactions up to this amount; larger ones require a super admin (USD).

reversalWindowDays.description: Completed transactions can be reversed within this many days.

maxOverdraftLimit.description: Maximum overdraft a manager may grant on a checking account (USD).

fdPrematurePenaltyRate.description: Penalty applied to principal when a fixed deposit is broken early (%).

minimumOpeningDeposit.description: Minimum initial deposit for savings and checking accounts (USD).

maxFailedLogins.description: Consecutive failed logins before the user is locked out.

lockoutMinutes.description: Lockout duration after too many failed logins.
